decisions.reason: This classic lever handle line sits within the firm's core design and fixing know-how, and architectural hardware runs on long lifecycles, so keeping and refining it is the natural choice even though it was not observed on the website in 2020 to 2021.
The multi-model handle family builds directly on established competencies and certified systems, so the firm can interpret its results and maintain it at low cost.

A single design close to the core offer is easy to assess with existing expertise, but its sibling C was already withdrawn and it has not been visible since 2018, which raises the risk of pruning somewhat.
A lever handle family with several models that draws on the existing knowledge base supports system breadth and is likely to remain in the range.
The flagship electronic access system matches the strategic push toward digital building organization, and in-house R&D gives the firm the absorptive capacity to keep developing it.
